# flutter_chat_pro

Backend-agnostic chat kit: models, SQLite cache, outbox, controllers, customizable UI.

- Import: `package:flutter_chat_pro/flutter_chat_pro.dart`
- App implements ChatSource (fetch rooms/messages, events stream, send, edit, delete, markRead), ChatUploader (media), optional ChatUserResolver
- Names/avatars: ChatPage(items:, hasMore:, users:) from fetch calls, UsersChanged event, kit.updateUsers(); kit stores and replaces them when they change; resolver only for missing ids
- Kit owns Drift cache (one DB per user), per-room sync, keyset pagination, offline outbox with retry
- ChatKit root + ChatKitScope; InboxController, ChatRoomController, ComposerController (ChangeNotifier, no Riverpod)
- ChatRoomView / InboxView (roomBuilder pushes the room with the style); every piece replaceable via ChatBuilders / InboxBuilders; CustomMessage + customBuilders for app types (e.g. offer)
- ChatStyle wraps any subtree: ChatPreset (classic, whatsApp, telegram, minimal, cards), simple options (seedColor, bubbleRadius, tiles: ChatTiles, ...), customize, scale; ChatStyle.push / carry keep it on routes
- ChatScale: size + text factor, re-read on resize/rotation; ChatScale(1.w, text: 1.sp) for flutter_scale_kit / screenutil, ChatScale.byScreen(), ChatScale.fixed(); options take design numbers (never .w)
- ChatTheme (ThemeExtension, grouped: ChatBubbleStyle, ChatRoomTileStyle plain/divided/card, ChatComposerStyle, ...; built by ChatStyle; scaled() for hand-built themes), context.chatTheme, ChatConfig, ChatStrings (app passes strings), ChatFormatters
- No firebase, supabase, dio, riverpod, slang in lib/
- Build order: spec/tasks/README.md
